items.title: HTML text-context marker
items.context: A confirmed HTML text reflection in a designated test page
items.intended_use: Test only whether a new inert element boundary can be created
caveats: Literal reflection or DOM presence is not script execution
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Attribute-boundary marker
items.context: A confirmed quoted HTML attribute reflection
items.intended_use: Test whether contextual encoding prevents leaving the current attribute value
caveats: Do not add event handlers, external resources, or credential forms
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Local execution proof
items.context: Only after an executable sink is confirmed in a designated browser
items.intended_use: Create a local DOM-visible proof without reading or transmitting data
caveats: Never access cookies, tokens, storage, personal data, or network endpoints
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.
